module.name: require-optional-chaining
module.description: Report repeated logical guards for manual review without changing falsy-value behavior.

scenarios.name: should allow existing optional chaining and unrelated guards
should report repeated logical guards without autofix
scenarios.then: a useOptionalChaining violation is reported without rewriting the expression

scenarios.name: should preserve falsy primitive values
scenarios.given: text && text.length where text is an empty string
scenarios.then: no autofix changes the empty string result into zero

scenarios.name: should preserve repeated getter access
scenarios.then: no autofix changes the number of getter evaluations
